_comment: The 30 sites in the founder's 'Backlinks SEO' Google Doc, probed 2026-10-12 and tiered by one question: would a person browsing here click through and play a free browser platformer? Tier A = honest fit. B = generic product-launch site, weak fit, free. C = do not submit (category mismatch or low quality). Probe facts are observed; 'follow' is the site's own claim, not verified.

targets.why: Not a directory. Publishing the devlog (marketing/devlog/) on a Hashnode blog earns a real link from a developer audience. Needs account.
targets.follow: links in posts are normal editorial links

targets.why: Has a Gaming category and advertises a do-follow link.
General web directory with a Games section. Old-school, low traffic, harmless.
Human-curated search engine; free URL submit; games category exists.
Side-project showcase; a free game made by one person fits. Marketplace framing: list as showcase, not for sale.
Digital product catalog; page mentions games heavily but submission path unclear. Check before use.
Product-launch site; accepts any product. Audience is founders, not players. Needs account.
Daily launch site for tools; a game is a stretch.
Tech-product launch site; weak fit. Needs account.
Tools directory with a free do-follow tier; a game is off-category.
Takes startups or AI tools; a free game is off-category.
Startup news and listings; weak fit.
Timed out on probe 2026-10-12; recheck before use.
